name.en: Scalar Ito diffusion: GBM and OU

formula: \mathrm{GBM}:\ a=\mu X,\ b=\sigma X;\quad\mathrm{OU}:\ a=\kappa(\theta-X),\ b=\sigma

note.ja: 決定論的初期値のスカラーSDE。平均・二次モーメントの弱誤差、共有Brown運動での強誤差、有限標本のMCSEを分けます。OUは調和Langevin系の浴成分に関連する追加検査です。
note.en: Scalar SDEs with deterministic initial states. Separate weak moment bias,strong errors on shared Brownian paths and finite-sample MCSE. OU is a related bath-component check,not the full harmonic Langevin system.

equation_note.ja: 幾何Brown運動のItô SDE dX=μXdt+σXdW。既存46式にはSDEの専用項目がありません。
equation_note.en: Geometric-Brownian Itô SDE dX=μXdt+σXdW; no SDE-specific entry exists among the 46 equations.

note.en: Euler–Maruyama for scalar geometric Brownian motion. Coarse/fine steps and analytic endpoints share the same Brownian paths; measure strong RMS error across 4096 paths. Does not validate general SDEs, MCMC or weak convergence order.

name.ja: GBMのweak誤差とMonte Carlo標準誤差
name.en: GBM weak bias and Monte Carlo error

scope.ja: 連続真値、離散EM期待値、同一経路差とMCSEを分離する固定入力です。
scope.en: Separate continuous truth,exact discrete EM expectation,paired-path weak difference and MCSE.

assumptions.ja: dX=.5Xdt+.4XdW,X0=1。無次元T=1、8/16/32/64刻み、独立32seed×1024経路。状態軸に境界・clipなし。

limits.ja: 弱誤差は期待値の差です。3SEや区間を真の誤差上界・一般被覆保証としません。1D状態×時間の保存例であり2D物理流れではありません。GBMやOU浴成分を新しい物理問題として重複計数しません。
limits.en: Weak error is a difference of expectations. SE/intervals are not true-error bounds or general coverage guarantees. State×time examples are not2Dphysical flow. Existing GBM/OUbath physical families are reused.

reference_note.ja: 軌道前にDecimal80/120・独立GH/OU共分散積分とpaired分散による標本解像を資格。各モーメントの5MCSE校正、MCSE精度、固定3段weak率、最後2段の3SE解像を判定。区間の被覆は離散真値に対する有限32反復の記述値。
reference_note.en: Before paths qualify Decimal80/120,independent GH/OUcovariance integrals and paired-variance allocation. Gate5MCSE calibration,MCSE precision,fixed three-level weak rate and final-two-level3SE resolution. Coverage is descriptive over32batches against discrete truth.

name.ja: 同じBrownian経路のMilstein・EM strong比較
name.en: Milstein and EM on identical Brownian paths

scope.ja: 補償項を持つMilsteinとEMの終端L2 RMSを、厳密端点と有限モーメントから検査。
scope.en: Compare compensated Milstein and EM endpoint L2RMS against exact endpoints and finite-moment identities.

limits.ja: L2終端誤差を扱い、原著のL1定義と区別。GBM以外の非Lipschitz系・正値性の一般保証はしません。既存gbm-sdeへの手法追加です。
limits.en: EndpointL2error is distinct from the selected paper L1definition. No general non-Lipschitz/positivity guarantee. This extends existinggbm-sde rather than adding a physical problem.

reference_note.ja: 相殺を含む解析MSEをDecimal80/120と独立1step GHで資格。二乗誤差の5SE校正、固定3段RMS率、最細段の優位性を判定。相関を保つ64pathblock jackknifeで率の不確実性を記述。
reference_note.en: Qualify cancellation-prone analytic MSE by Decimal80/120and independent one-step GH. Gate squared-error5SE calibration,fixed-three-level RMS rates and finest advantage.64paired path-block jackknife describes slope uncertainty.
